note: The relief cap of the globe over the country's heights (src/bodies/cap.ts, option `cap` of Planet; heights: country.json). border: radii of ground distance about the spot between which the height goes to 0. from: heights of the eye (radii) between which the relief grows from 0 to full. cells: cells along a side of each level. fine: a grid is drawn while the cells of its parent are larger than this many pixels. light: relief lights the levels that are not own by the globe's law with the heights' normal; own multiplies the own levels by 1 + lift of the heights' normal. The colour plates of the five country levels carry no slope light on made ground and carry the cast shadow of the heights (assets-src/mars/place/relight.py), so own must be 1 wherever those plates are seen. Values border, from, cells, fine as globe_engineer measured them (assets-src/shared/GLOBE-NOTES.md section 8). The Sun of the cap is the scene's Sun: the place stands on the globe with the bearing at which the light of the approved close image falls on the globe's Sun (plan.ts dive.headingDeg, MAIL 461 and 478). reachDeg: grids without height out to that half angle, so the border of the cap against the 320 segment sphere lies far from the place (without it a dotted dark line stood along the edge of the 8.5 degree square at frame 2713).
